001import pkg_engine.AssetManager;
002import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
003import pkg_engine.LoadingScreen;
004import pkg_engine.UserInterface;
005
006/**
007 * Application entry point for the Zuul-style Pokémon adventure game.
008 *
009 * <p>This class wires the {@link GameEngine} to the {@link UserInterface} so that player input is
010 * displayed and processed through a single {@code main} instantiate {@code Game} to start.
011 *
012 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
013 * @version 2026.02.17
014 */
015public class Game {
016    /** Swing-based view that shows text, images, and command controls. */
017    private UserInterface aGui;
018
019    /** Core game logic: rooms, parser, and command interpretation. */
020    private GameEngine aEngine;
021
022    /** Asset manager responsible for downloading missing files at startup. */
023    private AssetManager aAssetManager;
024
025    /**
026     * Constructs the game by creating the engine and GUI, then linking them.
027     *
028     * <p>The GUI receives a reference to the engine; the engine is given the GUI so it can print
029     * messages and update the display after construction.
030     */
031    public Game() {
032        this.aAssetManager = new AssetManager();
033        if (!aAssetManager.allAssetsDownloaded()) {
034            LoadingScreen vLoading = new LoadingScreen(aAssetManager);
035            aAssetManager.setLoadingScreen(vLoading);
036            vLoading.startAndWait();
037        }
038
039        this.aEngine = new GameEngine();
040        this.aGui = new UserInterface(this.aEngine);
041        this.aEngine.setGUI(this.aGui);
042    } // Game()
043
044    /**
045     * Entry point when running from command line. Creates a Game object to start the application.
046     *
047     * @param args command-line arguments (not used)
048     */
049    public static void main(String[] args) {
050        new Game();
051    } // main()
052} // Game
